flagged.evidence: Step 4.1's local error includes η(r² sup_{B_r}|D²u| + r^{2+α}[D²u]_{0,α;B_r}). Step 5.1 claims this yields a fixed γN(s_{j+1}) after controlling separated pairs by a separation estimate. For pairs at distance only comparable to r_j, converting the local Hessian-sup error to the global seminorm R^{2+α}[D²u]_{0,α;B_{s_j}} costs R^{2+α}r_j^{-α}η sup|D²u|, or η(R/r_j)^α relative to the R² sup|D²u| term in N. Since r_j→0, the fixed η chosen after the overlap constant cannot give the claimed uniform γ<2^{-(2+α)}; no other bound for those separated pairs is supplied.
